worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.summary: Raises a column of molten smoke from the body, then collapses it into a fire ring: foes in the ring are scorched and may burn. Fume style leaves smouldering embers that keep scalding whoever stays; Burst style loses the embers for one heavier ring.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.0: Scorch a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.1: Leave the foes pressed against you burning
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.2: Seal a patch of ground with embers
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.use.3: Break up melee pressure around you
The ring sweeps outward: each foe inside is resolved at most once for about %1$s damage, and the whole ring hits at most %2$s foes. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
It first raises a molten smoke column, then folds a %1$s-block fire ring outward from the feet, sweeping it within %2$s s.
A target scorched by the ring has a %1$s chance to burn for about 40 s: every 5 s it loses 1/16 of its own max health, and its physical damage is halved; Fire types are immune.
Fume style leaves embers for %2$s s, scalding everyone inside for about %1$s damage every %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.fume.on: Fume style on: ring power about x0.88 and its radius about x0.85 with +2 ticks wind-up, but it leaves smouldering embers that keep scalding, with cooldown +10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.fume.off: Fume style off (Burst): the ring is about ×1.1 power and widest, with no embers and cooldown −2 ticks, for one heavy hit on a group.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.growth.0: At level %1$s the ring rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks wide, and the burn chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.preference.f: On: about 12%% less ring damage, but smouldering embers keep scalding whoever stays, with cooldown +10 ticks, for sealing an area. Off: one heavier ring with no embers and a shorter cooldown, for hitting a group hard.
worldcombat.skill.lavaplume.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion waits outside the ring's reach; higher opens earlier but lets foes step away first.
With this on, the companion raises Lava Plume when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, so one ring catches the group; off keeps the normal attack order.
